AI Synthesis AI026 Euroack Line Interface User's Manual

This is the Manual for the AI026 Eurorack Line Interface you can purchase it by going to: https://aisynthesis.com/product/ai026-eurorack-line-interface/.

1. About the AI026 Eurorack Line Interface

The AI026 Eurorack Line Interface converts between +/- 2V Line Signals and +/- 5V Eurorack signals. This allows for the best headroom and highest quality when processing Line signals with Eurorack modules, and vice versa.

2. AI026 Controls

1. Line Level. This knob controls the volume of Line Level Inputs. This signal is at "unity" at approximately 3 o clock. Turning past 3 o'clock will provide more gain for non-normalized signals or for saturation.

2. Euro Level. This knob controls the volume of the Euro Level Inputs. It is unity at fully CW.

3. Line Level In. These are stereo inputs for Line Level Signals. The Left is normalled to the Right, so that when no cable is in the Right Input, the left signal will be passed to that input.
